item.title: Choosing a Palette
item.description: When it comes to choosing a palette for a project, there are too many options. A lot of these options and choices are naturally narrowed down by the both the core of the project and its scope; pixel art, for example, allows for the use of a breadth of colours — various shades, highlights, and supporting hues — to set the tone or convey a particular feeling or mood. When it comes to designing websites, however, there’s rarely any need (other than for an a bit of artistic flair, perhaps) to have more than a few base colours.

item.title: Reading for the Sake of Writing
item.description: I don’t read as much as I should. I have stacks upon stacks of books — spilling out of a bookshelf and across my desk, my coffee table, my other shelves — that are, for the most part, unread. Like many readers, I have a peculiar habit of frequently adding to my library and never quite catching up with it, and the time that I actually set aside for reading is becoming less and less.

item.title: Building arscorvi.github.io
item.description:
I like making websites.

I’ve always liked making websites. I wouldn’t necessarily consider myself a designer, developer, or coder — these are all words that I would use to describe someone who does this with much more frequency and demonstrable ability than I do — but I do enjoy making private little corners of the internet for my things. When it comes to languages, HTML and CSS are the ones that I am most familiar with for as long as I can remember; I used my rudimentary understanding of these languages as far back as the age of 14-years-old to design various little blurbs and rulesets for the games that I played and hosted, and that knowledge never really went away.

item.title: SS13 — Levi Ignis
item.description:
OVERVIEW

AGE: 27-years-old
RACE: Human
GENDER: Male
PROFESSION: Medical Doctor
BACKGROUND: Hot-headed Lapdog

A tempermental man most often seen working within the station’s medical department. Fiercely loyal to Nanotrasen and its interests, he can be a little unforgiving when it comes to matters of protocol and workplace security and is often angered by his colleague’s reckless behaviour. This underlying temper, however, is little more than a reluctant mask; in truth, he’s soft, caring, and compassionate, and will freely throw himself in harm’s way for the sake of others.

item.title: SS13 — Yuri Stratos
item.description:
OVERVIEW

AGE: 27-years-old
RACE: Human
GENDER: Male
PROFESSION: Medical Doctor/Director
BACKGROUND: Space-born Academic

A soft-spoken man with a passion for medical sciences and research; largely reserved and well-mannered, he’s quietly content with both his life and his working environment and demonstrates a strict adherence to protocol and ethics. Though situations outside of his control often push him outside of his comfort zone, he remains resolute in his desire to keep his colleagues and the people around him safe and sound.
